facts.raw_span: a 4-year history of a left lower eyelid mass
noted by his wife to have recently grown and acquired a crust
a yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule was discovered on the central lower eyelid without margin involvement
the tumor had acquired a flakier surface
The specimen measured 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.3 cm
Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
Central areas of clear cell change were periodic acid–Schiff positive and diastase sensitive
Negative results with Alcian blue and mucicarmine stains
Negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and androgen receptor
Ki67 highlighted scattered basal cells and stained about 20% to 40% of tumor cell nuclei

support_spans: Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present

concepts.why: The presence of a hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts, neoplastic squamous cells, and malignant cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli supports the diagnosis of squamous cell carcinoma.

support_spans: Central areas of clear cell change were periodic acid–Schiff positive and diastase sensitive
contradict_spans: Negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and androgen receptor
concepts.why: The presence of clear cell change with periodic acid-Schiff positivity and diastase sensitivity could suggest sebaceous carcinoma, but the negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and androgen receptor argue against it.

support_spans: a yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule was discovered on the central lower eyelid without margin involvement
contradict_spans: Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
concepts.why: The presence of a well-circumscribed papule could suggest basal cell carcinoma, but the proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells argues against it.
